deposits.intro: A deposit moves from the drawer to "cash in transit" 1190, and is confirmed by a bank statement line of the same amount in bank reconciliation.
deposits.gap: Ledger and documents differ: a manual entry on 1190 or a deposit from before this feature

settlements.title: Card network settlements (1251)
settlements.intro: A card sale is a receivable from the acquirer in 1251 until it transfers. A settlement claims receipts for a date range, so the net enters the bank and the fee and its VAT are recorded in their month.
settlements.gap: Ledger and receipts differ: a line on 1251 without a receipt, or a manual entry
